question: Who among the following won the ‘67th Filmfare Award 2022 for Best Choreography’ for the film Atrangi Re?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijay Ganguly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vijay Ganguly won the '67th Filmfare Award 2022' for Best Choreography for the film **Atrangi Re**.
 
• The award recognizes excellence in choreography within the Indian film industry.
 
• Vijay Ganguly is a renowned choreographer known for his innovative dance sequences.
 
• The film 'Atrangi Re' features popular actors like Akshay Kumar, Sara Ali Khan, and Dhanush.
 
• His choreography in the film was highly praised for its creativity and execution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Filmfare Awards:**

 
 
• Established in 1954, the Filmfare Awards are one of the oldest and most prestigious film awards in India.
 
• They are presented annually by The Times Group to honor artistic and technical excellence in the Hindi-language film industry.
 
• The awards are decided by both the public and a committee of experts.
 
• Categories include Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, and several technical awards.
 
 
 
• **Choreography in Indian Cinema:**
 
 
• Choreography is a vital aspect of Indian cinema, often involving elaborate dance sequences that are integral to the narrative.
 
• Indian choreographers are known for blending traditional dance forms with contemporary styles.
 
• Prominent choreographers in the industry include Saroj Khan, Farah Khan, and Prabhu Deva.
 
• Choreography awards recognize the creativity and skill involved in crafting memorable dance performances.
 
 
 
• **Atrangi Re:**
 
 
• 'Atrangi Re' is a 2021 Indian Hindi-language musical romantic drama film directed by Aanand L. Rai.
 
• The film's music is composed by A. R. Rahman, with lyrics by Irshad Kamil.
 
• The story revolves around a complex love triangle and explores themes of love, relationships, and mental health.
 
• The film received mixed to positive reviews from critics and audiences alike.
